$meta.status: Direction return — evidence awaiting acceptance, not an accepted design
$meta.themeStrategy: Semantic tokens only. Hosts rebind values (including a dark theme) without touching component semantics. This file defines the reference light theme.
$meta.contrast: Every fg/bg pair listed under color passes WCAG 2.2 AA; validation pairs recorded in HANDOFF.md.

sunken.role: Insets, wells, specimen frames, code/config blocks

scrim.role: Overlay backdrop behind sheets and drawers

tertiary.role: Supporting text, captions. Minimum text ink; nothing lighter carries information

onPrimary.role: Text and icons on ink.primary fills

strong.role: Emphasized borders: seals, inputs, active chips

ember.role: Brand thread, text-safe: links, active nav, live-operation accents

emberBright.role: Non-text only: focus ring, live pulse dot, active nav tick

live.meaning: Operation in motion: executing, submitted, confirming, awaiting_external. Paired glyph: ring (pulsing) or dashed ring when an external actor is awaited.

attention.meaning: A person must act or decide: action_required, awaiting_approval, changed terms, degraded sources. Paired glyph: filled square.

partial.meaning: Stable partial outcome: partially_succeeded. First-class destination, never rendered as an error. Paired glyph: half-filled disc.

success.meaning: Terminal success with named finality. Paired glyph: check inside disc; seal treatment on receipts.

danger.meaning: Terminal failure or duplicate-value risk. Paired glyph: cross. Never used for unknown outcomes.

neutral.meaning: draft, cancelled, expired, and unknown-outcome. Unknown adds a dashed border: unknown is not failed.

typography.law: Exactness has a typeface: every amount, address, hash, identifier, deadline and round number renders in families.exact with tabular figures. Prose, labels and actions render in families.ui.

amount.note: Hero amounts in review and receipt surfaces; families.exact

features.tabularNumerals: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on all families.exact text

space.density: Operational surfaces run at 8/12 internal padding; consumer decision surfaces at 16/20; page gutters 24/32.

control.applies: Buttons, inputs, chips, badges, evidence chips

radius.rule: No pills, no circles except spine nodes and the live pulse dot.

flat.applies: Default; structure comes from hairlines and surface steps

state.applies: Spine node and badge state transitions

pulse.applies: Live node ring only; one pulse per surface maximum

motion.reducedMotion: All transitions collapse to instant; the pulse is replaced by a static LIVE text tick. State change is always announced in text, never only by motion.

focus.rule: Focus ring is the brightest element on any surface; it is never suppressed.

iconography.set: Phosphor (regular weight), MIT license, delivered locally as inline SVG
iconography.rule: Icons never carry state alone; they pair with a text label or an accessible name.

signature.operationSpine: Vertical actor-owned rail. Node geometry encodes state class: filled disc = complete, ring = live, dashed ring = awaiting external actor, filled square = action required, half disc = partial, cross = failed, diamond = irreversible boundary.
signature.actorChips: Every step names its owner: You, wallet, protocol, named provider, agent, policy engine, operator. Providers keep proper names.
signature.evidenceChips: Mono truncated identifier + type label + copy affordance revealing the full value. Identical anatomy on every surface.
signature.terminalSeal: Bordered stamp reserved for terminal and partial outcomes with named finality. Live states never receive a seal.
signature.boundaryRule: A labeled horizontal rule in review sheets marking exactly where value begins to move.
signature.illustrativeTag: Notched chip labeling every fixture panel as Illustrative.
